reason: Preserve natural meaning while avoiding unsafe literal uppercase F/I bytes and placing source FI/FA/FO macros in their original command order.

records.english: Not a romantic bone in your body! Can't a man dream?
She was nearly scrap when we found her. Janus helped me restore that old wreck.
You're right, Claudio! We're going to sea. We just need the money. Julio might lend it to us!
Off to Julio's place, right now!
Hey, {MACRO:FI}!
Janus, Claudio, finish the repairs! You two are in charge!
Hey! Wait up, {MACRO:FI}!
The repairs are mostly finished, though, to be honest, nearly all the work fell to me...
He's always been like that; he rarely lets it show. How are repairs coming along?
Ha, true enough. Shall we join Raphael at Julio's place?
Yeah. {MACRO:FI} needs someone at his side. That's me.
All right, we heard you. Come on.
Sorry. This is a lot to ask.
Ah, so you're the {MACRO:FA} boy?
Sorry for barging in like this.
This time is different. We're serious! Stop hoarding your money and give us a loan!
You've never done a day's work. Why should anyone trust you now?
Please, Julio! The idea was mine! Surely there's something we can say to change your mind?
Hmm... That's quite a sum. Has your father agreed, {MACRO:FI}?
My father won't be part of this. We'll repay every coin. Please reconsider!
Wanting to stand on your own is admirable. Your determination is clear, but...
Enough. We won't ask again. Let's go, {MACRO:FI}. Janus, we're leaving.
Yes, yes, coming. Stop dragging me.
Sorry for asking so much of you. Please excuse us.
{MACRO:FI}, have you asked your father for help?
My father sees me as a child. He'd never let me board a ship.
Nothing will change unless we do something right now!
That's the spirit, {MACRO:FI}! Now that's a real man!
A noble thought, but we need money. Courage won't cover the cost.
This matter has given me a great deal to think about...
Very well. {MACRO:FI}, take this.
Now that the money's yours, every coin comes back to me, plus interest.
Still, my money worries me. That's why this old man is coming along. Someone must keep an eye on you.
Don't you understand? This old man is sailing with you.
Veteran, you say? You'll make me blush, though it has been a while since my last voyage...
Will this old man really be any use?
A veteran navigator is joining us? That's very reassuring.
Enough, Claudio. Julio is renowned as a skilled navigator.
And that brings us to you, {MACRO:FI}. You'll be captain of this ship.
Me?! Janus and Claudio rebuilt her!
The loan goes to {MACRO:FO}. As its leader, {MACRO:FI} {MACRO:FA} is responsible for repayment.
{MACRO:FO}?! Me, its leader?
You want to make your name among great sailors. Then show some ambition!
So {MACRO:FI} {MACRO:FA} will lead {MACRO:FO}, captain this ship, and command its fleet.
Put Claudio in charge? One mistake, and he'd spend the rest of his life paying off the debt...
N-no, thanks! {MACRO:FI} should lead. Right, Janus?
Agreed. Leading a company hardly suits me.
Just give it your best. That's all anyone can ask.
All right. Let's do it!
Good. That money will be your company's starting capital.
Thank you! Every coin will count!
Julio, we can't thank you enough!
Not bad, old man! Maybe you do have a decent side.
What was that, old fossil? You should be thanking me!
Looks like you need a little pain before you'll appreciate my greatness.
Heh heh heh! This old man can still beat a pup like you!
Not a chance! This fool still needs some sense knocked into him!
Oh yeah? You really want those fingers broken?
Captain's orders: that's enough!
Aye, Captain! Whatever you say!
Aye, Captain! Whatever you say!
Hmph! Nobody would ever imitate you.
Now then, ignore that fool. Good preparation is everything, so let's gather what we need.
Tch. He knows some things about ships, and now he thinks {MACRO:FI} needs lessons from him.
Enough chatter, Claudio. Let's go.
Let's get ready for the voyage.
Very well. Let's get started. We'll begin at the trading post.
Before leaving any town, visit its trading post, tavern, and square.
That's the spirit! Go on, then. Do your best out there.
